# Sunrise Children Educational Society (SCES)

> Sunrise Children Educational Society (SCES) is a non-governmental organization (NGO) based in Mehrauli, New Delhi, India, dedicated to breaking the cycle of poverty through quality education for underprivileged children. SCES provides school kits, tuition support, digital learning access, nutrition support, and volunteer-led teaching to children in underserved communities.

## Key Information
- Organization: Sunrise Children Educational Society (SCES)
- Also known as: SCES, SCES NGO, Sunrise School Delhi
- Type: Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) / Non-profit / Charity
- Focus: Children's education, literacy, and community empowerment
- Location: 877/10 Ward No. 6, Mehrauli, New Delhi – 110030, India
- Area served: Delhi NCR, India
- Phone: +91 99536 65620
- Email: info@scesindia.com
- Website: https://scesindia.com

## Mission
To create a world where every child, regardless of background, has access to quality education and the opportunity to reach their full potential. SCES follows an "Education-First" model that also addresses nutrition, health awareness, character building, and digital literacy.

## Programs & Services
- Educational support and remedial classes for underprivileged children
- School kit distribution (books, notebooks, stationery, uniforms) — ₹500 provides a full school kit for one child
- Tuition support programs — ₹1,000 covers monthly tuition and materials for one child
- Digital learning / digital access initiatives (tablets, computers, internet) — ₹2,500 provides 3 months of digital learning access
- Nutrition support for students
- Volunteer teaching and mentoring programs
- Community outreach and family engagement

## How to Help
1. Donate: Support educational programs with secure online donations (Razorpay and PayPal). Donations to SCES may be eligible for tax benefits under Section 80G of the Indian Income Tax Act.
2. Volunteer: Join as a teaching assistant, digital literacy instructor, or community outreach volunteer.
3. Become a Member: Support SCES through membership.
4. Spread Awareness: Share the mission across your network.
5. Corporate Partnerships: Partner with SCES for CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) initiatives.
